crossRefs.note: I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.
Then call, and I will answer, or let me speak, and you answer me.
How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.
“I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.
But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by man’s judgment. Yes, I don’t judge my own…
For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.

translations.web: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.
translations.bsb: I would learn how He would answer, and consider what He would say.
translations.kjv: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would say
translations.asv: I would know the words which he would answer me, And understand what he would say unto me.
